newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil small, medium industry had poor Q1 -- CNI.
newsitem.headline: Brazil small, medium industry had poor Q1 -- CNI.

text.p: Brazil's small and medium-sized industries had a poor first quarter with most reporting falling or stable sales and output levels, the private National Industry Confederation (CNI) said.
Of 650 companies interviewed by a CNI survey, 39 percent reported lower output than in the last quarter of 1996 and 37 percent said there had been no change.

Forty-two percent said their sales fell in the first quarter of 1997 -- only the electrical, autos and leather sectors showed growth -- and 63.8 percent said they expected their turnover to continue falling.

"This results shows an interruption in the pace of recovery in industrial activity when compared with the last quarter of 1996, but higher levels than in the first quarter of that year," the CNI said in a report on the survey.
